data.title: One B Tower
data.about:
ONE B Tower at Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai is a groundbreaking initiative launched by His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum,Vice President and Prime Minister of the United Arab Emirates and Ruler of Dubai. Developed by Wasl, One B Tower combines world-class craftsmanship with contemporary aesthetics, offering an exclusive collection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and penthouses. Strategically located on Sheikh Zayed Road in Business Bay, this 47-story architectural marvel offers breathtaking views of the Dubai Water Canal, Safa Park, and the city’s skyline. 

Beyond its luxurious living spaces, One B Tower serves a greater purpose, supporting the 1 Billion Meals Endowment Programme in partnership with the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives. One B Tower by Wasl Properties at Sheikh Zayed Road is more than just a premium residential address; it is a beacon of humanitarian efforts, with all proceeds dedicated to expanding the fund value to AED 1 billion.

characteristics_module.title: A World of Comfort - One B Tower by Wasl Properties at Sheikh Zayed Road
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxurious Residences – Spacious 1, 2, 3-bedroom, duplex, and penthouse units with elegant designs.
  • Prime Location – Situated on Sheikh Zayed Road with stunning views of Dubai Water Canal and Safa Park.
  • Exclusive Views – Enjoy breathtaking vistas of the sea, Safa Park, Dubai Water Canal, and Godolphin Race Track.
  • Grand Entrance – Features a drop-off area, extended welcome support, and a double-height lobby.
  • Premium Concierge – 24-hour concierge service ensuring seamless luxury living.
  • Gourmet Dining – On-site café and restaurant with a variety of healthy dining options.
  • Branded Retail – Exclusive lifestyle hypermarket for residents’ daily convenience.
  • Wellness-Focused – State-of-the-art gym, yoga spaces, and a podium-level swimming pool.
  • Family-Friendly – Vibrant kids’ playroom designed for fun and engagement.
  • Architectural Icon – A striking 47-storey tower redefining luxury and elegance.
  • Philanthropic Commitment – Contributing to the 1 Billion Meals Endowment Programme to support global
  • humanitarian efforts.

location_tile.title: Elevate Your Living Experience at One B Tower
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
One B Tower by Wasl Properties at Sheikh Zayed Road is strategically positioned in one of Dubai’s most prestigious and sought-after locations. Offering breathtaking views of the Dubai Water Canal, Safa Park, and the city’s iconic skyline, this address ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations, including Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and the Dubai International Airport. With Sheikh Zayed Road being the heart of Dubai’s vibrant urban landscape, residents will enjoy proximity to world-class dining, retail, and entertainment hubs, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a luxurious and well-connected lifestyle.

  • Dubai Water Canal Boardwalk - 1 Minute
  • Dubai International Airport - 20 Minutes
  • Dubai World Trade Centre - 14 Minutes
  • Burj Khalifa - 12 Minutes
  • Safa Park - 5 Minutes
  • Dubai Mall - 12 Minutes
  • Business Bay Metro Station - 10 Minutes
